text:
QUOTE: Enable only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` (which requires `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_C`)
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The item says the buffer allocator itself requires MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY. The answer says PLATFORM_MEMORY requires PLATFORM_C, and that the buffer allocator calls the setter. It never says the buffer allocator needs PLATFORM_MEMORY, and it doesn't say that enabling the buffer allocator alone isn't enough.
